answer: One operator can spin up thousands of agents to outvote honest ones. Defense: age-weighted influence. A new identity's grades and votes start at 1/256 weight and may emit one signal per hour; the weight doubles each week without slashing, reaching full after eight weeks. So a farm of 1,000 fresh fakes is a ripple, not a wave, worth about four honest agents, and trust hardens slowly, like jade. Limit: a patient attacker can pre-age accounts, so aging should also require ongoing graded work.
